facts.text: Students in UNA's Cole Honors College must take 18 honors credit hours and maintain a 3.25 cumulative GPA to graduate with honors.

sources.title: Current Student Information - University of North Alabama
sources.quote: Students must maintain a cumulative 3.25 to remain on scholarship and have “Honors College” on their diploma and transcript. Adequate progress toward completion of Honors coursework. Students are required to take 18 honors hours over their time at UNA.
